title: Sison: Allowing withdrawal of impeachment charges leads to mistrial

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — There will be a mistrial if the impeachment court allows the prosecution to withdraw three of four Articles of Impeachment and effectively prevent Vice President Sara Duterte from countering the evidence already presented, Atty. Sheila Sison said on Tuesday. Sison, lead counsel for the respondent, explained in her manifestation that the prosecution cannot “unilaterally determine” how the defense panel can proceed in terms of rebutting the evidence presented by the prosecution. But if the court does so, by allowing the withdrawal of the articles, it will show the “unmistakable characteristics” of a mistrial. READ: From Donki to Nike: Analyst […]...
